name: Gemini VI-A
about: Gemini VI-A (1965-104A), a crewed vehicle (Gemini), launched 1965 Dec 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1965 Dec 15), held fixed
